description: The plot illustrates the Perplexity (PPL) performance of the FreqKV model under three different compression ratios (γ = 0.25, 0.5, 0.75) as the context length increases from 2K to 64K tokens. The x-axis, labeled with context lengths “2K”, “4K”, “8K”, “16K”, “32K”, and “64K”, represents the number of tokens in a logarithmic scale (base 2), while the y-axis shows PPL values ranging from 7.7 to 8.2 in linear scale. The blue line (γ=0.25) starts at approximately PPL=8.2 at 2K, drops sharply to ~7.82 at 4K, then gradually declines to ~7.78 at 64K. The orange line (γ=0.5) begins at ~8.2, falls to ~7.75 at 8K, and stabilizes near 7.73–7.74 from 16K to 64K. The green line (γ=0.75) starts at ~8.2, drops to ~7.85 at 4K, then declines more gradually to ~7.72 at 64K. All three lines show a steep initial drop in PPL as context length increases from 2K to 4K or 8K, followed by a much slower decline or plateau, indicating diminishing returns in perplexity improvement beyond 8K tokens. The legend in the top-right corner identifies each line by its γ value and corresponding color and marker style (circle markers for all).
